title: PRIMES STEP Experience
summary: PRIMES STEP is a mathematical outreach program established at MIT in 2015. STEP students study advanced topics beyond the school curriculum and conduct group research projects, often leading to publication. This article discusses the program's history, admissions process, lesson organization, interactive teaching style, and teamwork, and provides advice on how to choose research projects, encourage students, and keep them engaged. This paper would be useful for math teachers and instructors in after-school math programs.
